# Home beverage appliances

SKU AUR-100 is the Aurora Home Brewer, a compact filter coffee machine sold as one appliance. SKU AUR-100B is the Aurora Home Brewer Bundle, which contains the AUR-100 machine, one thermal carafe, and a starter filter pack. These products have similar names but are separate sellable products and must not be treated as interchangeable in an order export.

## Replacement parts

SKU AUR-CAR-01 is the Aurora thermal replacement carafe. It fits both the Aurora Home Brewer and the Aurora Home Brewer Bundle, but it is not included with SKU AUR-100. SKU AUR-FLT-50 is a pack of fifty paper filters. Product titles in customer messages may omit a SKU, so support should confirm the order line before promising compatibility.

## Pantry products

SKU TEA-021 is Northstar Breakfast Tea, supplied as a box of 40 bags. SKU TEA-021D is Northstar Breakfast Tea Decaf, also supplied as a box of 40 bags. The regular and decaf products are distinct SKUs even though their packaging and unit counts are similar. A category label such as Beverages cannot establish product identity on its own.

## Product information limits

The catalogue identifies products and units; it does not establish current warehouse stock, dispatch date, refund eligibility, or promotion availability. Those questions require their relevant approved document or operational record. A support answer must cite the specific product SKU when a customer asks about a similarly named item.

## Naming and fulfilment checks

Order exports can contain a customer-written product description, an internal SKU, a bundle label, and a category at the same time. The internal SKU is the stable product identity for this catalogue. A title match is not enough when two records differ by a suffix such as B or D. Before changing an order line, support should compare the SKU on the order with the SKU in this catalogue and escalate any disagreement. The catalogue deliberately does not say that two products are substitutions for one another. A replacement carafe can be compatible with two brewer variants without becoming part of either brewer's original box.

## Catalogue maintenance

Product records are reviewed when a supplier changes packaging, units, or compatibility information. Until an approved catalogue update is published, customer support should not infer a new pack size from a product photograph, a search result, or a similarly named SKU. Archived titles can remain in historic invoices, so a historic name should be matched to its recorded SKU rather than silently mapped to a current product. This document is factual catalogue evidence only; it cannot authorize a refund, change a warehouse allocation, or alter a delivery commitment.
